phases.title: Unusual sightings
phases.summary: Forest observers report insects twice their usual physical size near Manaus: an impossible fictional mutation.

phases.title: Growing encounters
phases.summary: Some insects now reach four times normal physical size; the premise is explicitly fantastical.

phases.title: Ecosystem disruption
phases.summary: Insects eight times normal size are reported near another regional habitat; growth concerns size, not population.
